title: Codka Ka Soo Horjeeda Miisaannada Been abuurka ah
intro: Naf daacad ah ayaa lagu soo koriyey ganacsatada iyo ganacsatada dhul miisaankiisu la janjeero oo cabbirkiisu la gaabiyey. Qofkani wuxuu kaligiis ka soo horjeeday daacad-darrada qaran dhan, isagoo ugu yeeraya caddaalad iyo cibaadada Ilaaha keliya ee runta ah. In kasta oo farriintu caddayd oo baaqu ahaa mid caddaalad ah, haddana dadku way diideen inay dhegeystaan ​​waxayna la kulmeen qaddar ba'an. Ma ka aqoonsan kartaa rasuulkan sharafta leh Qur'aanka?
clues: Waxaa la ii soo diray farriin ahaan dad ay noloshoodu ku tiirsanayd ganacsiga iyo ganacsiga.
Dadkaygu waxay caan ku ahaayeen dhulka oo dhan inay bixiyaan miisaan gaaban iyo khiyaamo miisaan.
Waxay sidoo kale cabsi geliyeen dadka safarka ah ee wadada mara waxayna ku faafiyeen musuqmaasuq dhulka oo dhan.
Waxaan ku boorriyay inay caabudaan Alle oo keliya oo ay daacadnimo buuxda u muujiyaan macaamilkooda dadka kale.
Way diideen fariintaydii waxayna ku hanjabeen inay aniga iyo kuwa ila aaminsan dhulka ka saari doonaan.
Ilaahay wuxuu na badbaadiyay aniga iyo kuwa raacsan naxariistiisa, halka kuwa dulmiga falayna lagu qabtay ciqaab aad u xun.

trial.label: Dembiga Dadkayga
options: Dhisidda munaarad sare oo cirka ka soo horjeeda

outcome.label: Dhammaadkooda
options: Dabayl qabow oo xoog leh ayaa baabi'isay
Dhagaxyo dhoobo duban ah ayaa ku soo da'ay
Waxaa loo beddelay tiirar dhagax ah

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
